criteria.criterion: install.Section's interactive-session paragraph is, as one line and verbatim: `In an interactive session you are the operator's hands: follow the operator's playbook (/vloop:operate), not these session rules. To write a brief, follow /vloop:create-brief; to review one, run /vloop:review-brief in a separate session. If /vloop:operate is not available, the vloop plugin is not loaded: say so, give the user the two ways to load it (claude plugin install vloop@vloop after claude plugin marketplace add mvelosop/vloop, or claude --plugin-dir "$(vloop plugin path)"), and meanwhile work from vloop --help.` Every other line of the section is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: internal/install/section.go diff changes only that single line, text identical to the criterion.

criteria.criterion: `vloop init` in a fresh git repository writes a CLAUDE.md that is the section, in which `grep -c '/vloop:create-brief' CLAUDE.md` prints 1; install.MergeClaudeMD on a CLAUDE.md holding an older section between the markers replaces it with the new one and keeps everything outside the markers byte for byte.
criteria.evidence: The section is the single source for init, and the new text has /vloop:create-brief once. MergeClaudeMD is untouched and its existing tests pass (go check exit 0).

criteria.criterion: The existing tests that pin the section's text (internal/install/install_test.go) change only to the new paragraph, and the work notes name the contract item (K3); a committed test asserts the new paragraph, run by the `go` check. A section change with no test pinning the new line is a violation.
criteria.evidence: install_test.go:108 is the only test change, now asserting the new paragraph; proposal notes name K3; go check exit 0.

criteria.criterion: This repository's own CLAUDE.md is not edited (the operator's, at close), and vloop init's output gains no hint.
criteria.evidence: git status shows only section.go and install_test.go changed outside .vloop/.
